svg.title: Explain what a percentage counts
svg.desc: Twelve teams were invited to a trial. Nine replied and six would continue. The same six votes answer two different questions. Of the teams that replied. Divide 6 by 9. About 67 percent would continue. Of all invited teams. Divide 6 by 12. Exactly 50 percent said they would continue. Slide title. Name the group you counted so readers know which percentage they are seeing.
svg.text: Twelve teams were invited to a trial. Nine replied and six would continue.
The same six votes answer two different questions.
Divide 6 by 9. About 67 percent would continue.
Divide 6 by 12. Exactly 50 percent said they would continue.
Name the group you counted so readers know which percentage they are seeing.
